title: GSAG:Ce scintillator: insights from yttrium admixture
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2140-2151
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07622B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ondřej Zapadlík, Jan Pejchal, Vladimir Babin, Vítězslav Jarý, Vojtěch Vaněček, Romana Kučerková, Karel Jurek, Alena Beitlerová, Martin Nikl
Research on yttrium-admixed GSAG:Ce scintillators reveals that the stoichiometric composition enhances the light yield and reduces thermal quenching. It paves the way towards advanced cost-effective alternatives to GGAG:Ce scintillators.
